long_biography.plain_text:
IGD Grüter began in 1992 with a model that joined architectural planning to the construction and delivery of finished buildings. Its founder, Alois Grüter, built the Dagmersellen enterprise across housing, commercial premises and industrial projects. The firm would eventually work alongside property businesses in the same family group. At Solothurn, ACAMA Immobilien acquired a former factory site while IGD prepared its redevelopment; Grüter discussed the project's constraints as its investor.

After 32 years leading IGD, he transferred day-to-day management to his son Alain in April 2024. He remained chief executive, taking responsibility for acquisitions, relationships and the group's other companies. The transition continued at ACAMA, where his daughter Alissa later assumed operational management after planning by Grüter and his wife Claudia. The family continues to work across building and property development as the next generation takes on daily decisions.
